messages.author: c0732fe82bf7d917
messages.subject: Error with updateSelectInput
parts:
Hey Guys

I am getting the following error when I am trying to dynamically update a dropdown list on the UI. UI and Server code included.

Any pointers appreciated.

-Abhi

Error:
Error in .getReactiveEnvironment()$currentContext() : 
  Operation not allowed without an active reactive context. (You tried to do something that can only be done from inside a reactive function.)

#####
Code
#####

#UI
#####ui.r
shinyUI(
  pageWithSidebar(
    
    #application title
    headerPanel("Hello Shiny!"),
    
    #define the sidebar Panel
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput(
                  "obs",  #var name
                  "Number of observations:", #title
                  min = 1,
                  max = 1000,
                  value = 500 #default value
                  ),
        
      selectInput('test','test',choices='test')
        ),
       
      mainPanel(
       plotOutput("distPlot"),
    )
  )
)


#SERVER
##server.R

shinyServer(function(input,output,session){
  
  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    dist <- rnorm(input$obs)
    hist(dist)    
  })
  
  updateSelectInput(session=session,
                    inputId = 'test',
                    label='test',
                    choices = input$obs
                    )
  
})

messages.author: 4be88a5fc86a040f
messages.subject: Re: Error with updateSelectInput
parts:
It is in reference of updateSelectInput. See example section.
?updateSelectInput

The basic idea is that every reactive variable inside observe() is monitored for changes and when the change happens, the expression inside observe() re-runs. In your case the variable is input$obs.
Reactive outputs such as renderPlot/renderTable/renderUI/renderText act in the same manner, but updaters do not, so you need to wrap them in observe().

Reactivity overview is a nice start, but it is not exhaustive.
